import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title}

{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generates a secure HTML representation of an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or name of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). date : str The scheduled date of the event. notes : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for secure display of the event invitation. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (title, description, date, notes)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape all user-controlled input to prevent XSS safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Populate the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes ) return invitation_html
